name: Britannia Marie Gold
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA) (73%), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, INVERT SUGAR SYRUP MILK PRODUCTS (MILK SOLIDS & SWEETENED CONDENSED PARTLY SKIMMED MILK), RAISING AGENTS [503 & 500(i)], 10DISED SALT, MINERALS**, ARTIFICIAL (MILK & VANILLA) & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, EMULSIFIER (472e), DOUGH CONDITIONER (223), VITAMINS, COLOUR (150d) AND IMPROVER (1101(i)). (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System)
